profile: Alibaba Cloud security configuration metadata; exact actions, no first-class data contents
scope: All resources for the listed RAM actions. Not all Alibaba products/APIs, not automatic organization-wide access. Unlisted actions are explicitly denied where RAM evaluates this role's policy.
review_basis: Official API authorization tables, response schemas and field documentation; no live tenant access or policy deployment. Mixed sensitive responses and unbounded opaque configurations are excluded.
limits: Names, tags, DNS records, descriptions, IAM conditions and other configuration strings may contain improperly embedded secrets; IAM cannot redact arbitrary string contents.
Exact actions cannot prevent new sensitive fields in existing API response contracts; review schema changes before expanding or renewing this profile.
Resource Center/Cloud Config discovery is limited to supported, enabled and authorized resources; no unsafe generic configuration-detail reads are granted.
Kubernetes RBAC, public/anonymous access, separate credentials and services without RAM enforcement are outside this role-policy boundary.
Raw audit/log events, object names/contents, secret values, code, VM user data, credentials and captured security evidence are deliberately outside this profile.
